title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 18.0 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9,…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab CE/EE versions from 18.0 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 allowed an authenticated user to send requests to internal network resources due to insufficient validation during repository import. This issue has been remediated by GitLab.
